body: P2. #2078 cps/api/shelves.py:124,cps/shelf.py:907,cps/opds.py:987 bypass membership for public-shelf listings. Book detail cps/api/books.py:490 and cover helper1870 require browse_global; download helper2948-2957 requires personal membership for nonadmin. Real SQLite/helper probe: managed personal viewer sees public book1, regular lookup=None, actual get_download_link HTTP404; same user monolibrary resolves1. Managed viewer cannot self-add. OPDS acquisition also broken without membership for nonadmin browse-global viewer. Define safe public-resource continuation or actionable discovery flow, retaining existing content restrictions/private shelf ACLs. No demonstrated private-data leak. Main1ec1bfe677 audit2026-09-08.
title: Public shelf entries advertise resources unavailable to personal-library viewers
